newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ryder System estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ryder System estimates cut.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said Tuesday it reduced its 1997 earnings estimate for Ryder System Inc to $2.20 a share from $2.30 and its 1998 estimate to $2.50 from $2.60 to reflect continuing losses on residual sales of vehicles.

-- Gruntal said remained neutral on Ryder, which reported first quarter earnings of $0.43 a share versus $0.13 last year. The figure was in the consensus range of $0.35 to $0.52 a share, Gruntal said.

-- Gruntal said the insistent losses on residuals for a leasing company like Ryder suggests faulty forecasts of potential capital gains in prior years and an off-based projection of the future market for such vehicles.
-- Ryder is a truck leasing and rental company.
-- Its shares closed off 1/4 Tuesday at 31-1/8.
